properties.description: Silver orchestrator. Runs the silver_curated_* notebooks that take shortcut + mirrored + streaming data from bronze (via silver_raw) and write normalized, enriched, analyst-ready tables into the silver_curated lakehouse under Tables/dbo. All three notebooks are independent of each other (no shared writes) so they fan out in parallel; this pipeline completes only when all three succeed.

activities.name: silver_curated_retail_full
activities.description: Runs silver_curated_retail_full: joins customers, products, orders, order_items, stores, categories, brands, customer_segments and weather into the four core normalized tables (customer, product, order, order_line) with cross-source enrichment (lifecycle status, basket size, weather-at-order, etc.).

activities.name: silver_curated_weather_full
activities.description: Runs silver_curated_weather_full: derives the weather_daily table (with is_rainy / is_snowy / is_hot / is_cold flags) from the bronze weather shortcut so analysts have a clean per-store-per-day weather dimension.

activities.name: silver_curated_clickstream_full
activities.description: Runs silver_curated_clickstream_full: reads the Clickstream KQL table from the Eventhouse and sessionizes it into session + session_event Delta tables (entry/exit page, duration, conversion, bounce flag, etc.) in silver_curated.

activities.name: silver_curated_hr_full
activities.description: Runs silver_curated_hr_full: joins mirrored dbo.employees, dbo.job_titles and dbo.stores into a single denormalized employee table with title/department/store/manager + tenure/age/salary bands.

activities.name: silver_curated_ops_full
activities.description: Runs silver_curated_ops_full: passthrough conformance for the operational / supplier tables (inventory, payment, promotion, return, review, shipment, supplier, warehouse). Trims strings, normalizes statuses, derives helper flags (is_stockout, is_on_time, rating_bucket, usage_remaining).
